name: How long does a typical door trim repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door trim repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of door trim repair varies depending on the type and extent of the damage. Simple repairs, such as filling small dents and repainting, might take a few hours. More complex repairs involving cutting out and replacing sections of trim, or addressing significant rot, could extend to a full day or more, especially if custom matching or drying times for materials are required. We provide an estimated timeline after assessing the specific repair needs of your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few hours for minor fixes to a full day or more for complex issues like replacing sections or significant rot.
